rationale: The work spans persistent state, task scheduling, browser orchestration, repository protocols, review, integration, and recovery, with several independently testable components.

phases.title: Durable project protocol
acceptanceCriteria: Project, plan, task, and result files have versioned schemas.
The sample task graph is acyclic and references only known tasks.

tasks.title: Define durable project protocol schemas
tasks.description: Create the first version of the project, plan, task, and worker-result contracts used by ChatGPT Web planner and worker sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: Every contract has an explicit schemaVersion.
Unknown fields are rejected by default.
Task paths cannot be absolute or contain parent traversal.
Model routing is expressed as capability classes rather than hard-coded model IDs.

tasks.title: Add protocol invariant tests
tasks.description: Validate the example project graph and core safety invariants without introducing a runtime dependency.
acceptanceCriteria: Unknown and cyclic dependencies are rejected.
